about_item: [SUPREMELY COMFORTABLE ULTRA-LIGHT] - Enjoy unparalleled comfort with TOZO OpenEarRing, expertly crafted for high-resilience materials and featuring a secure clip-on design, with a single earbud is only weigh 5.1g, allowing you to enjoy music with a lightweight and pressure-free experience.

[TOZO EXCLUSIVE ORIGX ACOUSTIC TECH] - Hi-Res Stereo for Audiophiles & Movie Buffs—Our proprietary OrigX tech delivers crystal-clear stereo resolution, capturing every vocal inflection and instrumental layer music lovers crave. For binge-watching or movie nights, it restores vivid dialogue and immersive background details—from subtle rustles to dynamic soundtracks.

[DIGITAL DISPLAY& 40H PLAYTIME] - Enjoy music for up to 10 hours on a single charge with open ear earbuds. The charging case provides an additional 30 hours of playback, totaling an impressive 40 hours. The compact charging case with digital display and support Type-C charge, don't worry about low battery, enjoy music anytime,and anywhere.

[TOUCH AND ENJOY] - Simple button controls on TOZO OpenEarRing with your finger, make it easy to switch between answer/hang up calls, with just a press, effortlessly control your music and answer calls, It brings great safety and convenience when you are driving, exercising or running.

[CUSTOMIZE YOUR OWN EQ] - With TOZO APP to customize your favorite EQ mode, there are 32 EQ modes, allowing you to listen to various vocal music more accurately, such as jazz, blues, classical music, etc. Let's start your own music festival with TOZO OpenEarRing!

[ADVANCED BLUETOOTH 5.4 CHIP FOR STABLE CONNECTION] - Optimized anti-interference and strong signal penetration fix traditional Bluetooth pain points—high latency & frequent disconnections. Enjoy stable 15-meter connectivity whether you roam the bedroom with your phone in the living room, or play sports with your device left aside.

[EXCLUSIVE DESIGN FOR GLASSES WEARERS] - Engineered with glasses users in mind, each earbud weighs just 5.1g that delivering zero ear pressure even with all-day glasses wear. Snugly contours to ears without clashing with frames; our brand’s skin-friendly silicone ensures no irritation, making it a smart value choice for Glasses Wearers.

[EFFORTLESS ONE-STEP PAIRING] - Simply remove both earbuds from the charging case, and they will automatically pair with your device. No complicated steps required—just enjoy the convenience of technology with TOZO OpenEarRing clip on earbuds.

[IPX5 WATERPROOF] - TOZO OpenEarRing Built with protective nano-coating offer IPX5 water resistance, so that you don't have to worry about the interference of sweat and rain, let's open ear headphones be your best sports companion to tackle any outdoor pursuit.

[SKIN-FRIENDLY SILICONE] - TOZO OpenEarRing Clip-On Headphones made of skin-friendly silicone material, you don’t have to worry about skin irritation when wearing this headset, and you won’t feel uncomfortable even wear the headset for a long time.

summary.text: Customers find these earbuds comfortable, noting they barely feel on the ears and don't cause pain, while also appreciating their secure fit that stays in place perfectly. Moreover, the sound quality is good with clear phone calls, and the battery life is impressive, coming 100% charged and recharging quickly. Additionally, customers consider them excellent value for money. However, reliability and connectivity receive mixed feedback - while some say they consistently deliver excellent performance and connect easily, others report issues with the right earbud stopping working and randomly disconnecting for no reason.
